description: This file implements JNI bindings for PyTorch mobile, enabling model loading and inference on Android devices. It defines the PytorchJni class with methods for initializing models from assets or file paths, executing forward passes, and running specific methods, with Android-specific asset management code.

classes.name: PytorchJni
classes.description: JNI wrapper class for PyTorch mobile, providing methods to load models, execute forward passes, and run specific methods, with Android asset support.

methods.name: initHybrid
methods.description: Initializes the JNI object with model path, extra files, and device.

methods.name: initHybridAndroidAsset
methods.description: Android-specific initializer that loads model from asset.

methods.name: forward
methods.description: Performs a forward pass on the loaded model with given inputs.

methods.name: runMethod
methods.description: Runs a specified method on the model with given inputs.
